description: This file defines a class for configuring and interacting with the SearXNG search API, including transforming search requests and responses, validating environment, and constructing request URLs.

classes.name: SearXNGSearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with the SearXNG search API, including request transformation, environment validation, and response parsing.

methods.name: ui_friendly_name
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the search configuration, 'SearXNG'.

methods.name: get_http_method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for requests, 'GET'.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and prepares request headers, optionally including an API key.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full search API URL with query parameters.

methods.name: transform_search_request
methods.description: Transforms a generic search query and parameters into the SearXNG API request format.

methods.name: transform_search_response
methods.description: Converts the raw SearXNG API response into a standardized SearchResponse format.
